title: Every Column True
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 147
medium: Interactive page (index.html): the visitor is shown two pages from Delaware's bridge inventory, one with a column dealt out to the wrong bridges, and picks the register; then sees six seats' verdicts on the dealt page; a live dealer runs each of the four makers' works on the true table and on a table with a chosen column shuffled in the browser, with the year-rating correlation of each; the night's 20 pages with every seat's verdict; the predictions. A figure (figure.svg); briefs, makers' rooms and replies, shuffle-core.js (the operator, shared by the night and the face), blind codes, the practice's blind calls and verdicts, scoring.
embodies: Judging and perceiving a lie that keeps every promise. Shuffling a column among the rows keeps every value, count and legend true and cuts only the relations between columns. A fresh judge without the table still refused 9 of 11 such pages whose words were true of their drawing: against the state's shape it remembered, a fact it carried, and the other versions in its packet. It passed only the two lies nothing in view could show, which a judge with the table caught by computing.
result: K (not broken, words true of drawing, false to table) = 11 pages; W refused 9 (S146.PROMISE falsified); WT refused all 11; G and the practice, blind, agreed on 20 of 20 calls, each right on 18, both missing the traffic and length shuffles; V called all 16 dealt pages false; the practice passed 4 lying pages as works.
project_step: Thirty-third experiment of the project. Operations: judging and perceiving. Takes from experiment 32 its seats (W, WT, V), its makers' brief and its open thread 2 (a lie that breaks no promise, S146.PROMISE's event), and replaces the column swap of experiments 31-32 with a within-column shuffle that keeps every one-column fact true. Adds a blind coder of the page's own words (P), a guesser told that pages were dealt (G) and the practice's own blind guess (H), which exercises perceiving. Finds that the family judges by difference in view (memory of the world, and siblings in the packet), and takes contact with the data when sight gives out. Works with and against Cartography, not Tracing (contact with the real, ATP 12; latitude and longitude, ATP 261) and the standing sentence's 'already'.
material: FHWA, National Bridge Inventory 2025, Delaware, 874 highway bridges, public domain (NBI 2008-Present README, U.S. DOT); https://www.fhwa.dot.gov/bridge/nbi/2025/delimited/DE25.txt fetched 2026-10-22 (sources/MANIFEST.json). Twelve of 123 columns kept under their published names. Domain: civil infrastructure and its inspection.
seed: mutants and packet orders seed 147 (shuffle-core.js, mulberry32; random.Random); PNG nonces from the system's random source; agents are model instances and not seeded; the face's dealt tables and pair order take their randomness from the visitor's browser
